The '''69th [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''' honor the best in film, television, radio and video-game writing of 2016. Winners were announced on February 19, 2017, at [[The Beverly Hilton|Beverly Hilton Hotel]], [[Beverly Hills, California]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://awards.wga.org/wga-awards/awards-show-details |title=2016-2017 Awards Timeline |access-date=December 7, 2016 |work=[[Writers Guild of America]]}}</ref> The nominations for Television, [[New media|New Media]], Radio, News and Promotional Writing were announced on December 5, 2016,<ref>{{cite web |last1=Petski |first1=Denise |title=WGA TV Nominations: 'The Americans', 'Stranger Things', 'Westworld', 'This Is Us' Among Nominees |url=https://deadline.com/2016/12/wga-tv-nominations-the-americans-stranger-things-this-is-us-westworld-1201864546/ |website=Deadline |access-date=December 7, 2016}}</ref> while, the Theatrical and Documentary Screenplay nominees were announced on January 4, 2017,<ref>{{cite web |last1=McNary |first1=Dave |title='Deadpool,' 'Moonlight,' 'La La Land' Take Writers Guild Nominations |url=https://variety.com/2017/film/news/moonlight-la-la-land-manchester-by-the-sea-writers-guild-1201952295/ |website=Variety |access-date=January 4, 2017}}</ref> and the Videogame Writing nominees was announced on January 12, 2017.<ref>{{cite web |title=2017 Writers Guild Awards: Videogame Writing Nominations Announced |url=http://www.wga.org/news-events/news/press/2016/2017-videogame-writing-nominations-announced |website=WGA.org |access-date=January 12, 2017}}</ref>

The show was hosted by [[Patton Oswalt]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.wga.org/news-events/news/press/2016/patton-oswalt-to-host-2017-writers-guild-awards |title=Patton Oswalt to Host 2017 Writers Guild Awards L.A. Ceremony |date=November 16, 2016 |publisher=WGA |access-date=December 7, 2016}}</ref>
